title: GenesisSMP
description: Semi-Anarchy, Lightly Modded, Survival Minecraft Server
body:
Genesis is an SMP that is ussually based on the closest version of minecraft. There are mods such as LandClaim, TreeChopper, VeinMiner & Graves. Keeping the server close to vanilla is a high priority so the server runs on Fabric. 

### The LandClaims:
The land Claim has recipes that coraspond to its size, and can be upgraded. Though there is only one allowed per user. And a maxium land claim size of 35 blocks radius. To obtain the largest land claim you must gain pretty much every valuable material in the game beforehand.

### The Rules: 
We have rules, there is no cheating or exploiting allowed. This is meant to be a nice balance of anarchy while still giving room for PVP, Redstone Farms and builds. We allow swearing, but no sort of discrimination or bigotry. Those who are found hacking, will have video evidence posted to a discord channel, Then their Echest & Inventory will be put at their base and cords leaked. All distruction, Griefing, Stealing and killing is allowed outside of land claims. Lag machines are not allowed. There is a chat filter to stop our banned words from being sent and, to stop spammers since spamming is not allowed. 

The discord Chat is connected to the minecraft chat, making it so you can talk to people on the minecraft server at any time. The servers Border is quite small ussually taking a size between 15k to 5k blocks radius depending on the season. 

Thank you for reading the GenesisSMP Description, your host
-bup22
